generation.scope: On any regular finite-edge window with all corners satisfying the identities of four-by-four matrices, every balanced size-two or size-three simple has vertex Ext1 on at most one side. The only still possible mixed nonvertex profile under this bound is a rotation of (2,2,2,3). On every component the semiprime three-matrix-identity regular windows are exactly ordinary Clifford windows. The proof uses injectivity of Yoneda products through any family of PI-forbidden three-block chains and a bridge along a shortest vertex segment.

open_mathematics: Eliminate the remaining mixed (2,2,2,3) profile and analyze nilpotent PI extensions using the one-sided Ext criterion, as well as finite high-rank components.
